role: Beat-led score for OpenScout V3 Edit A (dark hero). The existing eerie/spacious openscout-montage-score.wav stays the bed for Edit B and was not regenerated.
why_generated: The brief allows one fresh MiniMax track for the beat-led edit only if existing assets contain no appropriate rhythmic counterpart. They do not: public/tracks/openscout/openscout-montage-score.wav is the ambient bed being reused for Edit B, public/tracks/blink/blink-spatial-score.wav is a calm chamber-electronic cue written for a different product, and the remaining public/tracks entries are unrelated library music.

generator.path: Preframe's configured MiniMax Music path (readMusicModelConfig + getMiniMaxApiKey)
generator.credential: Resolved from MINIMAX_API_KEY in the environment. Never written to disk or logged.
generator.note: The worktree had no .data/provider.json, so the music slot did not resolve until the main checkout's provider.json (both slots keyless) was copied in. .data/ is gitignored.

tempo.note: MiniMax did not honour the requested tempo. Rather than fight it, the film's grid was rebuilt on the delivered tempo and the master was nudged to a round value.
tempo.measurement: Positive log-domain spectral-flux onset envelope at 8 kHz / 64-sample hop, autocorrelated over 4 lags across the 62–107 s window; 0.02 BPM search resolution.
tempo.consequence: At 144 BPM one bar is exactly 50 frames at 30 fps, so Edit A's chapter grid is a whole number of bars (5+3+2+2+5+2+3+2 = 24) and every chapter boundary lands on a downbeat.

mastering.window: 62.2560 s → 107.28727 s of the raw generation, cut from a measured downbeat rather than an arbitrary point
mastering.why_this_window: The generation's first ~56 s is a sparse 10-second phrase cycle that decays to near silence; 56–108 s is the sustained, locked section. The window opens on a 2-second lift into that section and runs to where it thins out.
mastering.chain: atempo=1.0006949 → loudnorm(I=-18:TP=-1.5:LRA=9) → apad → afade in 0.35 s → afade out 3.0 s at 42.0 s
mastering.no_crossfade: Deliberate: a single continuous window keeps the pulse unbroken for the whole film and avoids the beat-phase flam a splice would introduce.

measured.duration_note: 83 ms short of the 45.000 s composition. The shortfall sits entirely inside the 3.0 s fade-out, which has already reached silence, so it is inaudible and leaves the picture unaffected. Comparable to the first montage's score, which measured -18.6 LUFS / -1.58 dBTP.

rights: Original instrumental generated for this project through the operator's own MiniMax account. No third-party recordings, samples or vocals.
